@@U04230@@
So much for him and his precious stick! Besides, it’s useless to us, what with that cross thing at one end!

@@U04232@@
What do we do now?

@@U04234@@
Do? It’s all but done! Hurry, now, my black little cousins, off to work at the mountain lake! Greet the Undines, and tell them we need to borrow some pretty water tricks. They have an art we havent, they’re female, they know how to separate illusion from reality so everyone thinks it’s the real thing.

@@U04235@@
(Pause.)

@@U04237@@
Our ravens must have flattered those ladies with a vengeance. I see a trickle beginning over there. And there a once dry rocky place is flowing rapidly. They can never win now.

@@U04239@@
What a grand way to greet them! Their boldest climbers are at a loss.

@@U04241@@
A single brook divides into many brooks that then leap out of gulches twice their size. And there, another, a river, casts its arching back far out and down,
translation:
@@U04230@@
他和他珍贵的棍子就这么多了！再说了，一端有那个十字，对我们来说没什么用！

@@U04232@@
我们现在做什么？

@@U04234@@
做吗？一切都完成了！快点，我的黑人小表弟们，去山湖边干活吧！向温迪妮一家打招呼，告诉他们我们需要借用一些漂亮的水戏法。她们拥有我们所没有的艺术，她们是女性，她们知道如何将幻想与现实区分开来，所以每个人都认为这是真实的。

@@U04235@@
（停顿。）

@@U04237@@
我们的乌鸦一定是对那些女士们进行了报复。我看到那里开始有一股细流。那里曾经干燥的岩石地方正在快速流动。他们现在永远不可能赢了。

@@U04239@@
这是多么盛大的方式来迎接他们啊！他们最大胆的登山者不知所措。

@@U04241@@
一条小溪分成许多小溪，然后从两倍大小的峡谷中跃出。在那里，另一条河，将它的拱形背影远远地抛向下方，
